case_classification.short_description: Very-very complex financial life plan model including debt, salary raises, tax and inflation - model for a married couple buying a house (no kids)

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is a highly complex wealth planning model covering an 84-year monthly timeline (over 1,000 rows) with several advanced features that require meticulous design. The salary and progressive tax engine requires modeling individual promotions (at non-standard intervals like 5.5 years) and tax brackets that inflate annually at 2%. Crucially, the home loan requires building a separate precise weekly amortization schedule with semi-monthly compounding and interest-only payments, which must then be mapped back to monthly periods. Finally, the monthly cash flow waterfall requires complex, sequential priority-based debt paydowns, dynamic emergency cash maintenance, and investment liquidation logic that can easily lead to circular references or formula errors if not carefully structured.
